newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma rebounds vs ecu, fx forwards up,bonds flat.
newsitem.headline: Drachma rebounds vs ecu, fx forwards up,bonds flat.

text.p: The drachma recovered most of the ground it lost earlier against the ecu helped by ecu selling from London-based banks that pushed ecu/drachma below 310 in late dealings, traders said.
Long depos were slightly higher and implied drachma rates from forex forwards were firmer across the board, hovering around 11 percent, dealers said.
Seven-year and 10-year bonds were steady at lower levels in late dealings with investors showing indifference for FRNs, bond traders said.

"Ecu/drachma is currently trading around 309.90/95 after hitting an intra-day high of 310.13/18 on earlier ecu buying from local banks," said a chief dealer at a foreign bank. "Ecu selling by London-based banks accounted for the drop below 310."
The central bank was checking mark/drachma today signalling to the market that it did not want ecu/drachma higher, the trader said.
"The 309.20 level has proven to be a strong support and it will be difficult to be broken on the downside," he said.
Money market dealers said long depos were marginally higher but trading was thin and forex forwards were firmer across the board.
Seven- and 10-year bond prices had stabilised after falling in early dealings, dealers said.
"Seven- and 10-year bonds are steady after coming under pressure in the morning," said a senior bond trader. "10-year bonds are well bid around 97.40."
The dealer said investors showed little interest in seven-year floaters due June 04 although they were attractively priced.
The mark was quoted at 157.53/63 from Thursday's 157.705 fix, the dollar at 275.60/70 drachmas from 276.380 and the ecu at 309.86/96 from 309.99 drachmas.
